07Sun 11 Oct · 19:00Carousel · 5 slides

Worried-homeowner Q&A (5-slide carousel)

Having the builders in? Here’s the stuff everyone asks me 👉 swipe

How long will it take?
Rough rule: a boiler swap is a day, a bathroom about a week, a patio 3 to 5 days, and a single-storey extension 10 to 14 weeks. You’ll get a start date and a finish date in writing, and if anything changes you’ll hear it from Jon first.

How much mess will there be?
Some. It’s building work. But dust sheets go down before tools come out, doorways get sealed off on dusty jobs, and we sweep up at the end of every day, not just the last one. Customers keep mentioning the tidiness, so we must be doing something right.

Will I need to move out?
Almost never. For a bathroom you’ll be without it for about a week; if it’s your only toilet, tell us and we’ll plan round it. For an extension, the kitchen’s out for a couple of weeks around the knock-through. Boilers: no hot water for a day.

What if you find something nasty?
Then you see it before it’s fixed. Rotten joists, dodgy old wiring, a leak nobody knew about: Jon shows you, explains it, and gives you the price. Nothing extra goes on the bill without you saying yes.

Got a question that isn’t on here? Ask it in the comments and I’ll answer it.

Extensions & conversions (clip Reel)

Thinking about a kitchen extension? 🏗️

A single-storey extension is usually 10–14 weeks, a garage conversion 3–4. It’s mostly outside; the knock-through is the dusty week, and you’ll almost never need to move out.

Lots of single-storey rear extensions don’t need full planning permission, but they all need building regulations sign-off. I’ll tell you straight which applies to yours before you spend a penny.

Guide prices for typical Cardiff jobs:
• Single-storey extension: £2,150–£2,450 a m²
• Garage conversion: £14,500–£16,500
• Glass roof lantern: £1,600–£1,800
• Upgrade to bifold doors: £2,400–£2,750

Got more than one job in mind? Book two or more in one go (say a bathroom and a new boiler) and it’s 3% off the lot: one skip, one set-up. Small repairs don’t count towards it.
